decision.reason: [ev-f64f7c540c6d] only says the flag `endpoint-status` was removed. It doesn't say whether a configuration that still sets it is ignored, rejected or stops the agent from starting. Instead it points to "the following Helm upgrade notes", and those notes are not in the evidence or the section context. The other items in the section ([ev-e477115a445b], [ev-0b06499d6851], [ev-b8b62ef806f0], [ev-91fac6720d6f]) say nothing about this flag. So nothing here supports the claim that the flag "will be ignored". To decide the consequence, we need the Helm upgrade notes for `endpoint-status` (for example, the Helm value it maps to and what happens to that value).
